First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop, non-stop dance party. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Seattle Bike Disco group ride

A rolling dance party that stops to dance in different parts of Seattle, rain or shine. Costumes and bike lights encouraged, not required. All bikes, genders and riders. Route posts the week of. Has a code of conduct.
